sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Assembly Members Salaries and Allowances Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1992
ACT I OF 1992
BALOCHISTAN
ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES,
AND ALLOWANCES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Assembly Members
(Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1975 (II of 1975)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th April, 1992]
No.PAB/LEGIS:III(I)/91, dated
30-4-1992.------The Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances)
(Amendment) Bill, 1991 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
Balochistan on 10th March, 1992, and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan,
is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
1. Short title and
commencement.-----This Act may be called the Balochistan Assembly Members
(Salaries and Allowances) (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 17th day of November,
1990.

sections.description:
Insertion of new section 5-B in Act II of 1975

ACT I OF 1992
ACT I OF 1992
BALOCHISTAN
ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES,
AND ALLOWANCES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Assembly Members
(Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1975 (II of 1975)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th April, 1992]
No.PAB/LEGIS:III(I)/91, dated
30-4-1992.------The Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances)
(Amendment) Bill, 1991 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
Balochistan on 10th March, 1992, and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan,
is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
5. Insertion of new section
5-B in Act II of 1975.--In the said Act, after section 5-A, the following
new section shall be inserted, namely:--
"5-B. Free
Travel Allowance.--(1) Every member shall be provided during a year with
vouchers of the value of thirty thousand rupees for the purpose of any journey
within Pakistan without payment of any fare by Air or by Rail:
Provided that where a person
becomes a member during the course of a year, the value of the vouchers with
which he is provided during that year shall not exceed the value which bears
the same proportion to thirty thousand rupees as the unexpired portion of the
year bears to a year.
(2) A member who does not wish to
be provided with such vouchers shall be paid traveling allowance of twenty-five
thousand rupees in cash during a year for the purpose of any journey.
